receipt: Fresh non-teacher LLM baselines scored for the v3.0.0 release on identical inputs. These models did not contribute to reference-label curation, so no leave-one-teacher-out adjustment applies.
split: beyond_confirmation labelled subset: 982 input records sampled from the N=1,025 beyond_confirmation split; category scored on the N=967 records with a category ground-truth label (adult N=952, junk N=913).
prompt: teacher prompt-v3 (12-label prompt taxonomy incl. other|unknown; off-taxonomy answers such as 'other'/'book' map to the unknown class index for scoring, identical rule for every LLM)
notes: Qwen3-8B is the local 8B-class baseline measured for this release; it is reported under its own name.
Qwen3-8B coverage: 982/982 records (352,233 total tokens across resume runs). Claude Haiku 4.5 coverage: 982/982 records.
Category accuracy is 11-class top-1 against unmutated ground-truth keys; Wilson intervals are 95%.
Off-taxonomy mapping was audited: ground truth for 'other'/'unknown' LLM answers is spread across real classes, so the mapping does not manufacture the local-8B gap.
